description.mn: Afnan Supremacy Gold: Unisex хув үнэр (EDP). Эхний ноот: нил цэцэг, задийн самар, тоорын цэцэг, зира; зүрхний ноот: пачули, цахилдаг; суурь ноот: ваниль, агар мод, хув, бензойн.
description.en: Supremacy Gold by Afnan Perfumes is a Oriental fragrance for women and men. Supremacy Gold was launched in 2013. Top notes are Violet, Nutmeg, Peach Blossom and Cumin; middle notes are Patchouli and iris; base notes are Vanilla, Agarwood (Oud), Amber and Benzoin.
